title: Convert a PSD finite charge filter into positive phase atoms
statement: For entrywise nonnegative physical charge weights, universal configurationwise positivity additionally requires PSD of their charge-index matrix. A Toeplitz Gram shift extends to a unitary, whose spectral measure supplies at most K+1 positive phase atoms matching the required moments. All-K existence is separate from the executed even-K rational compiler.
